scope: Seven migrated disclosure-set pages, plus Planning from the earlier hero review.
purpose: Page-by-page DA authoring work. This checklist does not apply changes or publish content.

evidence.content_source: Fresh local AEM preview HTML from port 3001 and disclosure preview delivery, plus existing repository authoring guides and prior live comparisons.
evidence.status_definition: pending_preview_or_edit means the preview lacks the intended result; first check whether the change is already saved in DA and only needs previewing.
evidence.correction_to_previous_review: Accounts and Brokerage currently return 200. Their earlier 404 observations are superseded. Planning still returns 404.

shared_tasks.action: Preview the seven already-saved migrated sets and any changed disclosure fragments.
shared_tasks.observed: All seven preview delivery endpoints return 200 but still expose the legacy number field rather than disclosureId.
instructions: Verify preview delivery returns the saved string disclosureId entries.
The schema and seven sets were reported migrated already; do not repeat or overwrite that migration.
Keep identifiers matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9]*$ and unique within each set.
Order the middle disclosures array in the required display order; retain each fragment’s stable ID while reordering.

shared_tasks.action: Save and preview each edited page, then verify it with the updated branch code.
instructions: Updated code must be available on the chosen branch host before remote review; the local review server already uses the working tree.
Check desktop and mobile layout, image loading, CTA labels/destinations/tracking and keyboard behavior.
Confirm all authored disclosure IDs resolve to actual footer items and the claim and footer show the same displayed number.
Verify rate data comes from the intended source, not local fabricated fixtures or a fallback mistaken for a successful response.
Publish page content, sets and fragments separately when the authored result is ready; saving/previewing alone does not update live content.

authoring_rules.ctas: Put each standalone CTA in its own paragraph. Inline terms/research links remain inside body-copy paragraphs.
authoring_rules.images: Retain existing valid generated DA media URLs; upload/replace only missing, incorrect or broken assets. Preserve appropriate alternative text.
authoring_rules.offers: Amounts, dates, promo codes, rich-text strikethrough and tracking links are authored campaign content. Review fixtures are snapshots.
authoring_rules.numbered_cards: Author one row per reason; JavaScript supplies the ordinal.
authoring_rules.disclosure_numbering: Authors write stable IDs in sup markers. Footer-set array order determines numbers and matching anchors.
authoring_rules.pricing_dependency: No dedicated detailed-pricing/table renderer exists for the imported fee-table block names; styling needs an agreed code/layout solution.
